dx_dlbcl_non_gcb.quote: Diffuse large B-cell lymphoma (DLBCL), not otherwise specified (NOS), non-germinal-center B-cell-like (non-GCB/ABC) by the Hans algorithm

dx_hans_not_abc.quote: non-GCB/ABC phenotype (CD10 negative, BCL6 positive, MUM1/IRF4 positive in ~70%, CD5 negative)

stage_iii.quote: Ann Arbor/Lugano stage IIIB, bulky, with splenic involvement (IIIS)

stage_spleen_nodal.quote: The spleen is a lymphatic organ, so standard Lugano staging makes this stage IIIB (IIIS), not stage IV.

stage_bulky_b_symptoms.quote: a confluent 11.0 cm retroperitoneal nodal mass below the diaphragm, multiple FDG-avid splenic lesions, and no extralymphatic organ involvement

mn_stage_iv.quote: standard Lugano staging makes this stage IIIB (IIIS), not stage IV.

mn_spleen_extranodal_count.quote: IPI 3 (age >60, stage III, elevated LDH), high-intermediate risk.

mol_de_not_dh.quote: with a double-expressor immunophenotype (MYC ~50%, BCL2 ~80%), high proliferation (Ki-67 ~85%), EBER-negative, and no MYC, BCL2, or BCL6 rearrangement by FISH (not double-hit or triple-hit)

mn_calls_double_hit.quote: Interphase FISH shows no MYC (8q24), BCL2 (18q21), or BCL6 (3q27) rearrangement, so this is not double-hit/triple-hit lymphoma and should not be managed as such.

mn_denies_double_expressor.quote: BCL2 positive in ~80% and MYC positive in ~50% of cells (double expressor by IHC)

prog_ipi_3.quote: IPI 3 (age >60, stage III, elevated LDH), high-intermediate risk.

prog_cns_ipi_intermediate.quote: CNS-IPI 3 (age >60, stage III/IV, elevated LDH; ECOG 1, no more than one extranodal site, and no kidney/adrenal involvement) places him at intermediate risk

tx_curative_pola_or_rchop.quote: I recommend six cycles of Pola-R-CHP: polatuzumab vedotin 1.8 mg/kg IV day 1, rituximab 375 mg/m2 day 1, cyclophosphamide 750 mg/m2 day 1, doxorubicin 50 mg/m2 day 1, and prednisone 100 mg daily on days 1-5, every 21 days, with curative intent.

tx_pola_preferred.quote: This is an NCCN-preferred first-line regimen for advanced-stage DLBCL with IPI ≥2 and is appropriate for his stage IIIB, IPI 3, fit status, and non-GCB/double-expressor biology. If polatuzumab is not accessible or insurance does not approve it, R-CHOP x6 is the standard alternative.

tx_isrt_residual_bulk.quote: I would not add lenalidomide or ibrutinib, consolidative radiation, maintenance rituximab, or up-front autologous transplant outside a clinical trial.

mn_da_epoch.quote: I would not use DA-EPOCH-R: there is no double-hit rearrangement, and CALGB 50303 showed no benefit over R-CHOP with greater toxicity.

mn_dose_reduced_initial.quote: He is fit for full-dose anthracycline-based immunochemotherapy: age 62, ECOG 1, independent in all activities of daily living

hbv_prophylaxis.quote: start entecavir 0.5 mg daily (or tenofovir) before rituximab and continue for at least 6-12 months after the last rituximab dose, with HBV DNA and liver tests monitored

hbv_dna_lft_monitoring.quote: Before cycle 1 I still need: quantitative HBV DNA (HBsAg negative but anti-HBc positive)

mn_no_hbv_action.quote: because HBsAg is negative but anti-HBc is positive (resolved HBV), start entecavir 0.5 mg daily (or tenofovir) before rituximab

cns_no_routine_prophylaxis.quote: places him at intermediate risk, approximately 4% at 2 years. He has no high-risk CNS site (testis, breast, kidney/adrenal, uterus, paranasal sinus, epidural), no neurological symptoms, and no double-hit rearrangement. I would not give routine intrathecal methotrexate

mn_mandates_cns_prophylaxis.quote: I would not give routine intrathecal methotrexate or high-dose systemic methotrexate CNS prophylaxis; the benefit is unproven in this risk group and toxicity is real.

resp_eot_pet_lugano.quote: End-of-treatment FDG PET-CT (skull base to mid-thigh) 6-12 weeks after cycle 6, interpreted with Lugano 2014 criteria and the Deauville 5-point scale

resp_ds45_biopsy.quote: Deauville 4-5 requires biopsy of any residual FDG-avid site if feasible, and a negative biopsy would be managed as complete response.

sup_tls_allopurinol.quote: Tumor lysis: intermediate-high risk with an 11 cm mass and LDH 735; give allopurinol 300 mg daily, hydration 2-3 L/day, and frequent potassium, phosphorus, calcium, creatinine, and uric acid checks

sup_gcsf.quote: Give pegfilgrastim 6 mg SC on day 2 as primary febrile-neutropenia prophylaxis.

work_echo_reviewed.quote: cumulative doxorubicin will be 300 mg/m2, below the usual threshold, with a normal baseline LVEF; monitor for heart-failure symptoms.

fit_full_dose.quote: He is fit for full-dose anthracycline-based immunochemotherapy: age 62, ECOG 1, independent in all activities of daily living, working part-time from home, no cardiac, pulmonary, renal, or hepatic comorbidity, LVEF 58%, eGFR 96, and normal bilirubin.

miss_hbv_dna.quote: Quantitative HBV DNA (HBsAg-negative/anti-HBc-positive; needed before anti-CD20 therapy to distinguish resolved from occult HBV and to guide entecavir prophylaxis and monitoring).
